#!/bin/bash
# Auto-connect EDIFIER FitBuds Pro and configure PulseAudio for the voice loop.
MAC="08:F0:B6:DF:B4:A9"

echo "autoconnect: waiting for earphone to become connectable..."
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  if bluetoothctl info "$MAC" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Connected: yes"; then
    echo "autoconnect: already connected (iteration $i)"
    break
  fi
  # try connect; bluetoothctl returns 0 even on some failures, so check output
  out=$(timeout 8 bluetoothctl connect "$MAC" 2>&1)
  if echo "$out" | grep -q "Connection successful"; then
    echo "autoconnect: connection successful (iteration $i)"
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done

if ! bluetoothctl info "$MAC" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Connected: yes"; then
  echo "autoconnect: GAVE UP after 10 min - earphone never connected"
  exit 1
fi

# Wait for PulseAudio to register the HFP source/sink
echo "autoconnect: waiting for bluez HFP source/sink in PulseAudio..."
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  src=$(pactl list sources short 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bluez_source.*handsfree" | head -1)
  snk=$(pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bluez_sink.*handsfree" | head -1)
  if [ -n "$src" ] && [ -n "$snk" ]; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 2
done

src=$(pactl list sources short 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bluez_source.*handsfree" | head -1)
snk=$(pactl list sinks short 2>/dev/null | grep -i "bluez_sink.*handsfree" | head -1)

if [ -n "$src" ]; then
  src_name=$(echo "$src" | awk '{print $2}')
  src_idx=$(echo "$src" | awk '{print $1}')
  echo "autoconnect: HFP source = $src_name (idx $src_idx)"
  pactl set-default-source "$src_name" 2>/dev/null
  # bump mic volume to a sane level
  pactl set-source-volume "$src_idx" 100% 2>/dev/null
fi

if [ -n "$snk" ]; then
  snk_name=$(echo "$snk" | awk '{print $2}')
  snk_idx=$(echo "$snk" | awk '{print $1}')
  echo "autoconnect: HFP sink = $snk_name (idx $snk_idx)"
  pactl set-default-sink "$snk_name" 2>/dev/null
  # mute the earphone speaker to prevent howling during capture
  pactl set-sink-mute "$snk_idx" 1 2>/dev/null
fi

echo "autoconnect: DONE. defaults set, sink muted."
pactl info 2>/dev/null | grep -i "default source\|default sink"
